containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
echo "===I3084_START utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache curl >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1; echo "apk_rc=$?"
for H in labels.sandbox01.shifamedcloud.ai mlflow.dev01.lazamedical.ai labels.dev01.lazamedical.ai; do
  echo "===DNS $H==="; getent hosts "$H" || echo DNS_FAIL
  echo "===CURL $H==="
  curl -k -m 10 -sS -o /dev/null -w "code=%{http_code} ip=%{remote_ip} time=%{time_total}" "https://$H/" 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo " rc=$?"
done
echo "===RESOLVE labels.sandbox01 -> 34.209.230.239==="
curl -k -m 10 -sS --resolve labels.sandbox01.shifamedcloud.ai:443:34.209.230.239 -o /dev/null -w "code=%{http_code} ip=%{remote_ip} time=%{time_total}" "https://labels.sandbox01.shifamedcloud.ai/" 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo " rc=$?"
echo "===MLFLOW_HEALTH==="
curl -k -m 10 -sS -o /dev/null -w "code=%{http_code} ip=%{remote_ip}" "https://mlflow.dev01.lazamedical.ai/health" 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo " rc=$?"
echo "===MLFLOW_ALB==="
curl -k -m 10 -sS -o /dev/null -w "code=%{http_code} ip=%{remote_ip}" "https://lazamedical-dp-dev01-usw2-mlf-2120029784.us-west-2.elb.amazonaws.com/health" 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo " rc=$?"
echo "===SANDBOX_IP_HTTP80==="
curl -m 10 -sS -o /dev/null -w "code=%{http_code} ip=%{remote_ip}" "http://34.209.230.239/" -H "Host: labels.sandbox01.shifamedcloud.ai" 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo " rc=$?"
echo "===I3084_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
